findings.description: The separator condition was inverted when the return expression moved into get_help_spec: it now uses "; " when any_prefix_is_slash is false and " / " when it is true, the opposite of the original code.
findings.rationale: Trigger: any ordinary option such as `-v, --verbose`, where no prefix is slash-style, so any_prefix_is_slash is False. The original code joined the spellings with " / ", but the new expression evaluates `not False`, so it joins with "; ", producing `-v; --verbose`. Slash-prefixed options like `--force/--no-force` are also affected. Because get_help_record now returns get_help_spec(), every option's help left column in the rendered --help output changes.
